skill.summary: Complete A-Z Discord server administration. Channel/role/member management, AutoMod, webhooks, templates, audit logs, scheduled events, threads, and full server control via CLI.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release.

- Provides complete Discord server administration via CLI, including channel, role, and member management
- Features advanced tools such as AutoMod, webhooks, templates, audit logs, scheduled events, and threads
- Supports bulk operations for channels, roles, members, and messages
- Includes message sending, searching, editing, and deletion (with bulk options)
- Covers advanced permissions, full server overview, vanity URLs, and detailed moderation capabilities
